title: On hold in deals
openDealsBody: Part of this stock is on hold in open deals. Cancel them, or let them complete, before you mark it sold or remove it.
manageNote: {{held}} on hold in deals. Mark sold and Remove come back once those deals are done.
quantityHint: At least {{held}}: that much is on hold in deals.
quantityBelowHeld: Can't go below {{held}}: that much is on hold in deals.
pauseMessage: Paused listings take no offers. Any open offers and backups on it will close for good.
editNote: {{held}} on hold in deals. The quantity can't go below it, and the unit can't change while deals or offers are open.
